# The dependency set pyright sees in CI.
#
# This MUST stay a superset of the unit-test job's installs. `reportMissingImports`
# is `none`, so a package pyright cannot import becomes `Unknown` and stops
# constraining anything — which means a leaner environment is not a more
# permissive check, just a DIFFERENT one. Errors that appear only for some
# people are almost always this.
#
# tests/test_pyright_deps.py asserts every type-checking workflow installs from
# this file rather than inlining a package list.

-r ../scripts/requirements.txt
